intro: Funded PhD in Counselling and Clinical Psychology (UTSC field, clinical psychology) at the University of Toronto for Fall 2027 entry. Application deadline: 1 December 2026.
description:
About the Position

The University of Toronto offers the PhD in Counselling and Clinical Psychology through the School of Graduate Studies, with a UTSC field in clinical psychology based at the University of Toronto Scarborough. This listing covers the Fall 2027 entry cohort; the graduate unit's application deadline is 1 December 2026.

The program trains doctoral-level clinical psychologists through coursework, research and clinical practicum training, and follows the standards of Canadian clinical psychology accreditation pathways as described on the official program page.

Research and Training Areas

  • Clinical psychology research methods and evidence-based practice
  • Counselling psychology theory and intervention
  • Psychological assessment and psychopathology
  • Clinical practicum training alongside dissertation research

Funding

Funding and support
ComponentDetails
Funding modelFunded doctoral cohort with an annual funding package (fellowship plus TA/RA components) per the program's funding commitments.
DurationFunding applies within the program's funded cohort timeline; confirm current values on the official page.
LocationUniversity of Toronto Scarborough and St. George campuses, Toronto, Canada.

Eligibility and Requirements

Academic and research preparation
CriterionRequirement
Academic preparationBachelor's degree (honours) in psychology or a related discipline; preparation in psychology expected for clinical training (see the official program page).
Application componentsOnline application via the School of Graduate Studies, transcripts, statement of interest, CV and reference letters per the program checklist.
EnglishEnglish-facility requirements per the University of Toronto School of Graduate Studies; international applicants should review test-exemption rules.

Application dates

Recruitment information
ComponentDetails
StatusOpen when checked on 22 October 2026
Deadline1 December 2026 (Fall 2027 entry)
EntryFall 2027
LocationToronto, Canada

How to Apply

Apply through the University of Toronto School of Graduate Studies (SGS) program page before 1 December 2026. Review the official admission requirements and the graduate unit's checklist carefully; clinical psychology programs are highly competitive and early, complete applications are strongly recommended.

About the University of Toronto

The University of Toronto is Canada's leading research-intensive university. Its Department of Psychology and the UTSC clinical psychology field provide doctoral training connected to major teaching hospitals and research institutes in Toronto.

Official Link

  • Official advert and application (verified link)
  • All SGS graduate programs (official)

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 1 December 2026 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
